approval.required: User approves the exact final protocol before any comparison runner execution. Claude persists it to docs/fyp2/task10a/comparison_protocol.json; this draft alone never authorizes a run.
approval.hash_binding: The expected SHA256 of the final approved protocol is recorded in a separate user decision record and supplied to the runner, never embedded as this file's own hash.

scope.purpose: Describe how fixed source-domain still images and a fixed synthetic pairing propagate through the unchanged R10/EMA/fusion/FSM pipeline when only the vision model changes.
scope.chapter6_policy: Never promote demo/rehearsal hit rates or RiskLevel counts into Live evaluation results. Any future use as a constructed protocol diagnostic requires explicit provenance and limitations; no Live or safety label.

authority.precedence: Direct user instructions and C-1..C-12 govern this draft.

preflight_context.note: Runner must record its own implemented HEAD/dirty state; the observed preflight HEAD has no candidate integration.

prerequisites: Stage-1 provider integration and three-model behavior evidence complete and independently audited; user's U-1 Stage-1 audit passed
FUD-01 tolerance approved before any Stage-1 comparisons
User approves and freezes this protocol before runner execution
Candidate copies are real directories in Live System with validated manifest/hash; stable vision and stable telemetry remain unchanged
All input, model, metadata and fixed telemetry hashes reverified; failure means BLOCKED/FAILED with exact path, no substitutions

input_set.name: stable200
input_set.selection_rule: From frozen validation metadata, group c0..c9; sort filename ascending within each class; take first20.
input_set.sequence_rule: Concatenate c0 first20, c1 first20, ..., c9 first20; no shuffle, no interleaving, no duplication, no class-boundary reset.
input_set.second_package_annotations: Must be identical to the RN annotations; same sha256 in today's preflight.
input_set.membership_hash_rule: sha256(UTF8('\n'.join(sorted(filename for all200 annotations)))); no trailing newline. This is the frozen filename membership hash, not the CSV bytes hash and not the source_id hash.
input_set.source_ids_hash_rule: sha256(UTF8('\n'.join(sorted(source_id for all200 annotations)))); no trailing newline.
input_set.image_bytes_manifest_hash_rule: For all200 source_ids sorted lexicographically, concatenate source_id+'\t'+sha256(original JPEG bytes), join with '\n' and no trailing newline; hash UTF-8 bytes.
input_set.image_hashes_status: MEASURED_READ_ONLY_IN_CX0_2026-10-26; these new input-byte pins are not historical model benchmark results
input_set.hash_verification: Verify metadata, both annotations, frozen membership, source-id hash, every original JPEG sha256, and image manifest aggregate before each model run; reject any missing/mismatch with exact path. Persist recomputed hashes in results.
input_set.transport: base64 of the exact original JPEG bytes, with no decode/re-encode, crop, canvas, mirroring or augmentation.

time_basis.timestamp_formula: t_i = t0 + i*100 milliseconds using integer milliseconds / timedelta; ISO8601 UTC serialization
time_basis.injection: In each child, patch app.inference.datetime to an isolated clock whose now() returns t_i before each synchronous TestClient POST, following backend/tests/test_temporal_contract.py:fake_clock. Also align the provider processed_at metadata clock (app.providers.trained.datetime); do not change real perf_counter or model math. Verify exported timestamp and freshness ages equal the declared policy.
time_basis.wall_execution: No real-time sleep or playback pacing. Synthetic event time advances only between completed synchronous requests. Host elapsed timings, if recorded, are diagnostics and excluded from the model behavior comparison.
time_basis.validation: t0 is in the past relative to the run date, so the unchanged schemas.normalize_timestamp future guard accepts it. Require all returned windows fresh, age0 and assessment_available=true; if not, fail runner validity.
time_basis.fsm_interpretation: 20 images per class cover 1.9s between first and last observation; adjacent blocks begin 2.0s apart. Changes at block boundaries reflect this constructed order and EMA carry. No inter-frame motion or real dwell time exists. A single Low class block cannot demonstrate10s sustained Low recovery.

observation_identity.epoch_policy: epoch=1 for the single synthetic acquisition stream in each isolated session; only a restarted stream would increment epoch. index increases per frame.
observation_identity.request_id: task10a_w0001 through task10a_w0200; unique within the session; same aligned IDs allowed across isolated model runs
observation_identity.source_identity: source_id from ordered_samples; driver_id is dataset provenance only, never face/biometric inference.
observation_identity.r10_policy: Every window declares new frame identity and a new synthetic telemetry observation; no retries, repeats or missing modalities are scheduled. Equal telemetry values with increasing seq/time are intentionally new synthetic samples.
observation_identity.verification: Assert provenance.vision_obs=new and telemetry_obs=new, exactly200 persisted monotonically numbered windows, canonical acquisition times equal t_i and model hashes match selected identity.

telemetry_pairing.selection: First data row, CSV window_id=1; chosen by row position before model results, not by desired risk output.
telemetry_pairing.features_hash_rule: Convert all eight values to Python float, then sha256(UTF8(json.dumps(features,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False))); preserve float encoding e.g.34.0.
telemetry_pairing.probabilities: Compute using unchanged XGB-STABLE for each raw input; ignore CSV p_safe,p_aggressive,p_distracted. No expected P(Safe) or fused risk values are invented in this draft.
telemetry_pairing.rationale: Keep the telemetry branch identical across all windows and all models, isolating the vision-model change. This pairing is constructed, not an observed joint driving event.

fixed_configuration.fusion: Existing decision-level late fusion; weights are transparent design parameters, not learned safety weights.
fixed_configuration.freshness: Ruling A unchanged: age>3s => missing/factor0, no stale scoring;3s is a design threshold, not a validated safety threshold.
fixed_configuration.ema: Existing R10 NEW-only vision EMA; fresh empty initial state, seed on first sample; no reset within200windows, including class boundaries.
fixed_configuration.fsm: Existing R10 server-time AND NEW-source-span rules;2s High,10s Low; repeat observations do not advance source span and last advancing modality must still support the level.

isolation.mechanism: Run one fresh OS subprocess per compared identity, sequentially in the declared model order. Set all DRA_* variables before importing app.*; no backend.app.* duplicate imports.
isolation.model_env: DRA_ACTIVE_VISION from compared_identities.env_value; stable is default
isolation.database: A different newly created temporary directory and DRA_DATABASE_URL=sqlite:////<absolute-temporary-path>/comparison.sqlite per model. No user driver_risk.db path is opened.
isolation.state: A fresh provider singleton, application/cache state, session and SQLite per child. Maintain EMA/FSM across all200windows within that child only. No shared in-memory session or reused SQLite.
isolation.application: fastapi.testclient.TestClient against app.main:app, create LIVE_MODEL_RUNTIME session with explicit fixed runtime_config; POST /api/sessions/{session_id}/infer for every window, real provider (no probability stubs in evidence runs).
isolation.ports: No TCP listener needed; never use port8000.
isolation.logging: Any fault sink/export path configured by the runner must also resolve inside that child's isolated temporary/evidence directory.
isolation.identity_check: Read /api/models and each result's vision_model_id/sha256, plus stable telemetry hash, before accepting results; missing/mismatched identity => failed validity, no fallback.
isolation.provenance_note: Current backend emits vision_source=camera_frame for any image. Preserve server values; explicitly label this run as constructed dataset input in the enclosing protocol/results. Do not spoof unsupported client dataset_replay fields or claim the input came from a camera.

fields: 10 class probabilities in canonical c0..c9 order
summaries: per-window aligned probabilities and model pair deltas
per-class argmax sequence and count distribution
comparison_quantities.meaning: Model-output behavior; argmax agreement between models is not accuracy.

summaries: min,max,mean,p25,median,p75,p95 on available values; NumPy quantile(method=linear)
RN-minus-stable and MN-candidate-minus-stable paired deltas, no significance claim
comparison_quantities.meaning: Operational0..100risk values under fixed synthetic pairing, not accident severity.

summaries: aligned disagreement windows and class-boundary positions

comparison_quantities.meaning: Unchanged existing evidence rule; no redesigned weighting or dominance rule.

summaries: every transition with window,source_id,t_i,from,to and class-boundary context
comparison_quantities.meaning: Constructed sequence response; not a real-world alert-delay or false-alarm evaluation.

fields: raw and EMA vision non-safe probability
summaries: describe relative branch contribution and attenuation under the chosen fixed telemetry value
comparison_quantities.meaning: Descriptive diagnostic only. A single fixed telemetry row cannot establish general multimodal benefit.

operational_reference_policy.reference: Execute the current committed fusion/EMA/R10/FSM policy with the declared configuration. Dataset class labels only group visual outputs; no per-class ground-truth RiskLevel/AlertSeverity labels are assigned.
operational_reference_policy.correctness_scope: Existing regression tests and Stage-1 checks establish implementation contracts separately. Stage-2 differences are described; no single metric wins.
operational_reference_policy.known_weakness_context: Read frozen P4 clean/E1 evidence for c9 as a historical context check. Do not force stable200 to reproduce pooled test metrics or p050 outcomes; stable200 is a different validation subset.

decision_rule.no_safety_equivalence: Higher Macro-F1, lower RiskScore or fewer alerts does not prove safer driving.

result_contract.protocol_first: Before loading models, require status=APPROVED, recorded explicit user approval, expected protocol SHA, and protocol_mtime_ns < run_start_epoch_ns. Recompute SHA after run; it must match. Record output_mtime_ns > run_start_epoch_ns. File mtime alone is not approval.
result_contract.probability_alignment: Map runtime safe_driving alias back to c0; align all10labels explicitly; never rely on display sorting or top-k truncation.

validity_and_failure_policy.missing_input: BLOCKED with exact missing path; no synthetic replacement inputs.
validity_and_failure_policy.hash_or_manifest_mismatch: FAILED/BLOCKED with exact path and expected/actual hashes; no silent substitution.
validity_and_failure_policy.inference_failure: Record HTTP error/exit code and failed validity; no prepared-probability or stable fallback.
validity_and_failure_policy.identical_results: If all raw probabilities and all downstream results are identical across identities, withhold interpretation and investigate loading/selection/caching. Equality of coarse RiskLevel or argmax alone is possible and not by itself proof of a broken runner.
validity_and_failure_policy.expected_valid_run: Exactly200 successful persisted windows per model; real selected identities, same image bytes/telemetry/config/clock schedule. Missing modalities, unavailable results, repeated observations or cross-run leakage invalidate this prescribed scenario.
validity_and_failure_policy.posthoc_changes: No threshold, ordering, telemetry row or timing change after seeing outputs. Any revised approved protocol gets a new version/hash before a new authorized run.

limitations: Validation subset, not a new independent held-out test; no reselecting trials/seeds from these outputs.
Still-image class blocks and synthetic timestamps create FSM transitions; temporal coherence and real driver dwell times are absent.
Fixed telemetry is not synchronized with image actions and cannot measure general complementarity.
No real camera, frontend capture/render or physical device is exercised by TestClient.
No conclusion about frontal-camera reliability, UAT, edge performance, vehicle-grade deployment or safety.
P4A100/211 parity is historical and distinct from both200member smoke and this future paired system comparison.

for_user_decision.subject: Stage-1 三模型数值容差
for_user_decision.proposal: 每个有参照的集合分别要求 max_abs_prob_delta <= 1e-4 且 argmax_agreement == 1.0；200 帧 per_class_mode_equals_label 单独评估；超限如实失败，不事后放宽。

for_user_decision.subject: Stage-2 输入及顺序
for_user_decision.proposal: stable200：c0..c9 各类 filename 升序取 validation 前20，按10个连续类别块运行；P4A100/211只作历史附录。

for_user_decision.subject: Stage-2 时间与观测策略
for_user_decision.proposal: 固定UTC合成起点2026-10-25T00:00:00Z，间隔100ms；200窗口i=0..199；同一epoch=1，frame.index=i+1，telemetry_seq=i+1，两种源时间均等于该窗口注入时间。

for_user_decision.subject: 固定遥测配对
for_user_decision.proposal: 所有窗口使用 prepared_sessions/session_001/telemetry.csv 第一数据行的8项原始特征；只更新合成时间与seq，运行稳定XGB，不采用CSV中的预设概率。

for_user_decision.subject: Stage-2 协议整体批准
for_user_decision.proposal: 批准正式协议及其sha256后才允许runner运行；每模型一子进程+独立临时SQLite、真实provider+TestClient /infer、固定融合配置、描述性比较，Stage5由用户作替换决定。
